snippet.title: Scorched Sun - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Go check it out on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4086480/Scorched_Sun/

Scorched Sun is a short experience that combines top down survival horror with turn based combat. As a new initiate, delve into the depths of a monastery of the Scorched Sun order and discover the secrets within.
